verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect version-change documentation. The docs describe what Llama 3.1 adds (function calling, agent-optimized inference) and say it can be a drop-in replacement. The canonical llama-models repo also keeps a per-family model-card table from Llama 2 through Llama 4. Nothing shows a dedicated changelog or ongoing release notes, and the developer docs sit behind an SSO wall, which limits how easily they can be followed. Missing for 10: a dedicated maintained changelog/release-notes page, API/CLI change history, a subscribable update feed, and independent confirmation that change notes are kept current.
